description: Runs a Monte Carlo simulation (thousands of trials) estimating the odds that a client's savings and contributions support a stated retirement income target. It does not assume a fixed withdrawal rule such as the 4% rule; the target income is an input. Results are reported under each of several named forward-looking market scenarios by default. An educational planning aid, not a recommendation.

annual_contribution.description: Amount contributed per year, in today's (real) dollars, during the years between current_age and retirement_age

current_age.description: The client's current age in years

current_savings.description: Current portfolio balance in today's (real) dollars

desired_annual_retirement_income.description: The client's own target annual retirement income in today's (real) dollars — required; this tool will not assume a withdrawal rate

equity_weight.description: Fraction of the portfolio in equity-like assets, 0-1 (default 0.6)

retirement_age.description: The age the client plans to retire and begin withdrawals

scenario.description: A single scenario id to run one scenario only — omit to run the default set and see the range

name: advisor.retirement_monte_carlo_estimator
title: Retirement Cash-Flow Monte Carlo Estimator
